meta.title: SkinLedger — CS2 skin arbitrage ledger
meta.description: Find out what you actually earn on skin arbitrage: deals, fees and profit in one ledger.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to get back to your deals
auth.signUpSubtitle: Create an account and start tracking your deals

landing.headline: Find out how much you <accent>actually earn</accent> on skins
landing.subtitle: SkinLedger replaces your spreadsheet: log the deals, and it works out the profit for you — fees and exchange rates included.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to log deals and see the real picture

profit.title: Real profit
profit.text: Buys and sells with platform fees and exchange rates — you see net profit, not a rough guess.

dashboard.title: Dashboard with charts
dashboard.text: Profit by month, a cumulative curve, top-5 winners and losers, and a breakdown by selling platform.

import.title: Flexible import
import.text: Excel, CSV or text pasted from notes — upload the table as it is. Any column names, currencies and date formats are recognised instantly, with nothing to rename.

currency.title: Multi-currency
currency.text: RUB, USD, EUR and CNY with live rates. Change your base currency and every deal is recalculated on the fly.

catalog.title: Catalog of ~33,000 items
catalog.text: Skins, stickers, agents, cases, capsules, charms, patches and graffiti — autocomplete by name.

list.title: Flexible deal list
list.text: Filter by period, status and platform, search by name and sort by any column.

landing.plannedNote: Leave your email and we'll write when it ships. It also tells us what to build next.
landing.plannedAutoImportNote: Pull deals in automatically, with no manual exports.
landing.plannedAlertsNote: Get notified when an item you follow reaches the price you want.
landing.footer: SkinLedger — a ledger for CS2 skin arbitrage.

waitlist.thanks: Thanks! We'll write as soon as it's out.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.goalHint: Progress towards your personal profit goal for the current calendar month (regardless of the period filter). Set the goal in Settings.
dashboard.netProfitHint: Total profit on closed deals for the selected period: revenue minus costs, with fees and exchange rates applied.
dashboard.turnoverHint: Total of all sales for the period (revenue after the selling fee). Shows trading volume, not earnings.
dashboard.roiHint: Portfolio ROI: total profit ÷ total costs × 100. Weighted by deal size — larger deals count for more.
dashboard.avgMarginHint: The arithmetic mean of margin across deals. Every deal counts the same regardless of size — the typical profitability of one deal.
dashboard.avgProfitHint: Net profit ÷ number of closed deals in the period.
dashboard.bestTradeHint: The largest profit on a single deal in the period.
dashboard.avgHoldHint: How many days pass on average between buying and selling. Lower means capital turns over faster.
dashboard.frozenHint: Purchase cost of every unsold position (a snapshot of right now, ignoring the period filter).
dashboard.holdingCountHint: How many items are still unsold. "Sellable" is how many have cleared Steam's 7-day trade ban.
dashboard.deadCapitalHint: Money stuck in holdings for more than 60 days. Candidates to dump and free up capital.
dashboard.deadCapitalCount: {count, plural, one {# position} other {# positions}} held > 60 days
dashboard.topProfitHint: The five most profitable deals in the selected period.
dashboard.topLossHint: The five biggest losses in the selected period.
dashboard.byPlatformHint: Profit and actual margin per selling platform. Margin = total profit ÷ total cost on that platform × 100.
dashboard.noClosedDeals: No closed deals in this period.

charts.monthlyProfitHint: Net profit by month (by sell date). Green bars are gains, red are losses.
charts.cumulativeHint: Profit accumulated month over month — the overall earnings trend.
charts.monthlyRoiHint: Return on capital for each month: that month's profit ÷ cost of what was sold in it × 100. The number that matters most in arbitrage — more than absolute profit.
charts.marginByHoldHint: Average margin by holding-time bucket (≤7 / 8–30 / 31–60 / >60 days). Shows whether long holds are eating your returns.
charts.marginByHoldNote: Long holds often eat into returns
charts.empty: No closed deals in this period

deals.title: Deals
deals.deleteAllBody: Every one of your deals ({total}) will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
deals.tradeBanLeft: Trade ban: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
deals.emptyNoDeals: No deals yet. Add your first one and you'll see the profit before you even save it.
deals.emptyNoMatch: Nothing matched the filters. Change or reset them.
deals.dialogHint: Profit is calculated as you fill the form in.

dealsToolbar.periodNote: The period filters deals by sell date, the same way the dashboard does. Deals on hold are shown regardless of the period: they have no closing date.

dealForm.legacyName: Current value: "{name}". Pick an item from the catalog to attach the canonical name.
dealForm.remainderNote: The remaining {n} will stay on hold as a separate deal.
dealForm.calcHint: Enter the buy price — the breakdown will appear here

settings.title: Settings
settings.currencyNote: Every amount (prices, profit, dashboard) is converted into your base currency at the current rate. Change the currency and all deals are shown in the new one.
settings.goalNote: Set a net-profit goal for the month and a progress bar appears on the dashboard. Empty or 0 removes the goal.
settings.passwordNote: Changing your password signs you out everywhere — sign in again with the new one.
settings.platformsNote: Add platforms that aren't on the list and set their fees — they'll be filled in when you pick a platform for a deal or import one.
settings.ratesFallback: Using fallback rates (the rate source is unavailable)
settings.deleteAccountNote: Deletes your account and all data (deals, your own platforms) with no way to restore it.
settings.confirmBody: Your account, all deals and your own platforms will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. Enter your password to confirm.

platforms.name: Name
platforms.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. If the platform is used in any deals, the deletion will be rejected.

importPage.title: Import deals
importPage.subtitle: Upload your spreadsheet as it is
importPage.bullet1: Excel (.xlsx), CSV or text from your notes — there's nothing to rename, we recognise columns by their headers and by their values. Banners and totals above and below the table are skipped automatically.
importPage.bullet2: Wear can go straight into the name: AWP | Corticera (Minimal Wear) — we'll pull it out.
importPage.bullet3: After upload we show a preview: how the columns, currency and date format were recognised — all of it is editable before importing, and the import can be rolled back.
importPage.template: Not sure where to start? Download a sample template (CSV)

import.fileLabel: Your file: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV — as it is
import.textLabel: …or paste rows from notes / a spreadsheet
import.textPlaceholder: Item name	Quality	Buy price	Buy date
import.feesNote: If you pick "Not included", the recognised platform's fee is applied to sales (Steam 13%, Market.CSGO 5% and so on). A fee column in your table always takes priority.

prices.saveAsTemplate: Save the current settings as a template
prices.templateActiveNote: Filter changes are saved to this template. "+" creates a new one and restores this template's previous settings.
prices.templateEmptyNote: Set up the filters and press "+" to save them as a template.
prices.showChart: Show the chart and order book
prices.noOrderHistory: Order history isn't collected — the source only reports the current order price

offers.showMore: Show {count, plural, one {# more platform} other {# more platforms}}

item.metaDescription: {name}: {priceLine}. Price comparison across marketplaces, history, and the best flip after fees.
item.ogDescription: Prices across {count} marketplaces, a chart and a profit breakdown.
item.faqPriceQ: What is the current price of {name}?
item.faqPriceA: The lowest price across {count} tracked marketplaces is {low} ({source}). The median across marketplaces is {median}. Prices are refreshed on a schedule and stored in our database.
item.faqVariantsQ: How much do the other variants of {name} cost?
item.faqProfitA: The best flip right now: buy on {buySource} for {buyPrice} and sell on {sellSource} for {sellPrice}. After buying, selling and withdrawal fees that leaves {profit} ({pct}).
item.faqLiquidityA: Over the last 30 days {sales} sales went through on tracked marketplaces, and {offers} offers are listed right now.
item.noOffers: Prices for this item haven't been loaded yet.
item.profitNote: We work the profit out before you buy, like an itemised receipt: buy price, sell price and every platform fee. To find flips like this across the whole catalog, use the <link>comparison table</link>.
item.bestOrdersNote: One best order per marketplace: the price source doesn't expose order book depth.
item.thinNote: This item has prices on fewer than two marketplaces, so the page is excluded from indexing until there's more data.
